one_liner: Zoho CRM has a broad REST API (v8) with OAuth 2.0 and an official vendor-hosted MCP server set (four pre-built servers); free edition and free trial exist, though free-tier API access is not confirmed by the supplied pages.
auth_notes: OAuth 2.0 is documented for the MCP servers; the Composio catalog independently lists OAUTH2 as the only managed scheme for Zoho. The supplied pages do not directly describe the REST API token flow, API keys, or client-credentials, so those are unconfirmed.
access_notes: Zoho's homepage advertises a free trial and a freemium edition (3 users). The supplied pages do not state explicitly that the free edition includes API access; the earlier claims from the ZoomInfo and API-limits pages are not among the supplied pages and were dropped. Trial access is the evidenced path; free-edition API access is unverified.
blocker_notes: MCP is vendor-published on zoho.com (the MCP Registry vendor namespace is empty, but that does not contradict the vendor's own docs). API calls via MCP consume API credits. Free-edition API availability is not confirmed by the supplied pages; a free trial is available as a fallback.
